description: Every paycheck recorded in the document — gross, net, the employer’s own contributions, total compensation, the effective tax rate, what payroll put away, and whether each itemization reconciles to its net. Plus the salary months with no paycheck at all, per-year totals, and **the deduction-type vocabulary with its ids**, which is what a line of a new paycheck has to name. Reads the document; changes nothing.

include_lines.description: Also print each listed paycheck’s itemization, line by line. Default false.

limit.description: How many paychecks to list, newest salary month first. Default 24, maximum 500. The yearly totals and the vocabulary are never capped.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: paychecks
title: Paychecks
